ننطرق (form VII)
# نَنْطَرِقُ (nanṭariqu) /nan.tˤa.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# نَنْطَرِقَ (nanṭariqa) /nan.tˤa.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# نَنْطَرِقْ (nanṭariq) /nan.tˤa.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
